newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel firm, sellers holding back.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel firm, sellers holding back.

text.p: NWE jet fuel was steady on Friday buoyed by slightly higher benchmark futures and firm premiums, traders said.
On the cif cargo market, premiums were assessed at Oct IPE +$35/+$36.
There was talk that one or two cargoes could be enticed over by current arbitrage opportunities, but this was not confirmed.
Traders said jet was available, but sellers were not offering because of a lack of interest.
Mediterranean jet availability was reported to be slightly easier. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7714
